user.title: Live Track Aircraft
user.description: Aircraft within the radius appear on the map as they arrive and depart on their own. Point it anywhere — it defaults to your Home Assistant location, but you can watch any airspace in the world.

data_description.location: Drag the marker to the middle of the area to watch.
data_description.radius_km: How far out counts as overhead.
data_description.max_aircraft: A safety ceiling, not a display limit. Filter the map card to show fewer.
data_description.military_areas: Optional. Every military-flagged aircraft inside these circles is drawn, past the maximum. latitude,longitude,km separated by semicolons: 39.81,-84.04,150; 34.0,-117.8,463
data_description.follow_hexes: Optional. One code per aircraft is enough. Each aircraft is drawn wherever it flies, past the maximum. Six-character Mode S codes, as on an aircraft's identity attribute, separated by commas. At most 100.
data_description.follow_callsigns: Optional. One code per aircraft is enough. Whatever aircraft broadcasts one of these call signs is drawn wherever it flies, past the maximum. As broadcast, airline code and number, separated by commas: UAL1234, DAL89. A call sign names a flight, not an aircraft. At most 100.
data_description.adsblol_api_key: Optional. Your own key from adsb.lol, sent only to adsb.lol, which is asked when adsb.fi is not answering. Without one, adsb.lol allows 500 requests a day from your address. Clear the field to stop using it.

error.invalid_location: That point is not on the globe. Drag the marker onto the map.
error.invalid_military_areas: Each circle is latitude,longitude,km with 1 to 2000 km, at most ten, separated by semicolons.
error.invalid_follow_hexes: Each hex code is six characters, 0-9 and a-f, at most 100, separated by commas.
error.invalid_follow_callsigns: Each call sign is 2 to 8 letters and digits, no spaces, at most 100, separated by commas.

abort.already_configured: Aircraft are already tracked for this location and radius.

map_card_duplicate_resources.description: These dashboard resources also load the map card: {urls}. Only one is used and the others do nothing. Remove them in Settings > Dashboards > Resources.
